tournament.name: November OCC - Qualifier B
tournament.description:
• Qualifier Brackets - November 13th @ 1300 GMT (deck list deadline November 13th @ 1200 GMT)


  • The qualifier brackets are seeded based on the position of the player on the OC leaderboard at the end of the season.


  • Round of 8 Finals - November 21st @ 1300 GMT (deck list deadline November 18th @ 2300 GMT)


  • The Round of 8 Finals are seeded based on OC leaderboard at the end of the season in addition to the final 2 qualified players being positioned in #7 and #8.
